ledger.claim: This trip's own trace establishes a material route deviation. The governing field under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km — 54.16 km — measured against the booked optimal of 36.0 km, giving an excess of 18.16 km and 50.44% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (18.16 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold and 50.44% is greater than the 20% relative threshold), and the same excess also clears 8.0 km and 50%, so the deviation is additionally MATERIAL. I rely on the derived trace figure, not on trip_record.actual_distance_km, which POL-RD-01 forbids for the threshold test.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00105 with a matching 2026-07-15 14:33 pickup window, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to excuse the excess.

POL-RD-08's extra corroboration requirement does not attach to this claim. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0 — far below the 4-and-1 trigger — so a threshold-crossing excess of this size needs no evidence beyond the gps_trace and the rider's claim is not exposed to that filter.

The driver's explanation cannot exonerate. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory that names the affected road or segment with a validity window overlapping the time the vehicle would have reached it. EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING — no LTA advisory covers the PIE eastbound in the 14:26-15:44 window — so the clause is simply unavailable, and the driver's bare assertion that 'traffic was heavy' names no artifact and discharges nothing under POL-RD-08. ledger.claim: POL-RD-04 is not available on this record. That clause exonerates only a detour attributable to a rider instruction, and the chat log contains none: the rider's two messages ask why the vehicle was heading toward the city and report passing Bedok, while the driver's single reply is 'reaching soon'. No message carries a waypoint_hint and no road is named, so there is no rider-requested detour to exclude.

POL-RD-05 does not apply. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, original_pickup and original_dropoff are null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so no endpoint was relocated and there is no amended re-quote against which to re-run POL-RD-01. The booked 36.0 km optimal stands as the baseline for this trip.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not run and the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 36.0 + 0.28 x 42.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 42.56 + 0.80 = SGD 43.36. Refund = charged_total 65.13 - 43.36 = SGD 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80. That is 33.4% of the charge, so it is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below the 90% full-refund share on this limb alone.

Because POL-RD-01 records a MATERIAL deviation, POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is mandatory, and it produces a pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 4, at or above the clause's threshold of 3. Limb (b) therefore licenses FULL_REFUND of charged_total — SGD 65.13 — instead of the POL-RD-02 partial of SGD 21.80, and I put the two side by side so the uplift is visible. I disclose that EV-DPROF-00105 is IMPAIRED: issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT, weight_multiplier 0.75, snapshot taken 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour threshold. The counter is 4 against a threshold of 3, so the pattern finding survives the discount. No pass-through line is uplifted — ERP and surcharge are both zero.

POL-RD-06(c) additionally requires the case to be referred to driver-conduct review. That referral belongs in the ruling's referrals list and, under POL-GEN-03, does not displace or delay the monetary ruling in the rider's favour.

POL-RD-10(5) makes this a mandatory escalation trigger, and its own worked example is exactly this situation - a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory. Escalation is terminal: the disputed SGD 65.13 is held rather than collected or refunded, because no artifact on the file can decide whether the 54.16 km route was externally justified. The evidence that would resolve it is the LTA incident or advisory log for the PIE eastbound on 15 July 2026.

If the judge rules on the merits rather than escalating, the refund must be the POL-RD-02 recomputation of SGD 21.80 and not a SGD 65.13 full-fare uplift. An uplift that doubles the award should not be built on a stale snapshot, and the judge must state whether the pattern finding survives the discount and why.

The fare carries no line that can be refunded on top of the distance-and-time figure. erp_gantries is empty and both the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are SGD 0.00, so there is no off-route gantry charge to correct; and the SGD 0.00 airport_surcharge line is correct rather than a defect, because the Changi surcharge applies only to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this trip terminates there. With no phantom gantry and no wrongly applied surcharge, POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to refund as a standalone correction and the driver's monetary exposure is confined to the single POL-RD-02 computation.

No adverse finding may be built on this driver's history beyond the two counters POL-RD-06 actually names. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this decides dispute DSP-00105 on trip TRP-00105 (Jurong East to Changi T1, 15 July 2026).

1. The deviation is established and material. The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-00105: 54.16 km against the booked optimal of 36.0 km on EV-TRIP-00105, an excess of 18.16 km, or 50.4% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 tests pass (over 0.8 km and over 20%), and the excess also clears 8.0 km and 50%, so the deviation is additionally MATERIAL. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: coverage 100%, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, a steady 10-second sampling interval, 427 fixes. None of POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is met, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no POL-RD-10(3) trigger fires.

2. The driver's traffic explanation does not excuse the route. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming the affected road or segment with a validity window overlapping the trip. EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING from the pool (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and a missing artifact carries no fact; there is no advisory for the PIE eastbound in the 14:26-15:44 window. POL-RD-04 is likewise unavailable: the chat log EV-CHAT-00105 holds two rider queries and a 'reaching soon' reply, with no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no named road. POL-RD-05 does not apply: no pickup or dropoff was amended (pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null), so the booked 36.0 km optimal stands.

3. I have not escalated. The driver's advocate asked for POL-RD-10(5). That trigger is not met: the driver named no artifact for the traffic assertion, and POL-RD-08 tells us what to do with a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID - it carries no weight, is discarded, and does not discharge the driver's burden. POL-RD-10(5) escalates where an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited but missing artifact; a bare assertion cites nothing, and treating every traffic assertion as an escalation would let any driver freeze any deviation case. The record is decidable, so it is decided. The escalation request is rejected.

4. The money. EV-FARE-00105 shows a METERED fare, so POL-RD-11 does not run and POL-RD-02 fixes the arithmetic. The rider's POL-RD-08 burden is discharged - trip_id TRP-00105 and the 14:33 pickup window match across trip record, trace and fare - and no extra-corroboration filter attaches (rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0). recomputed_fare = 3.80 base + (0.75 x 36.0 = 27.00) distance + (0.28 x 42.0 = 11.76) time + 0.80 platform fee, at surge 1.0 with no ERP, no surcharge and no promo = SGD 43.36. The POL-RD-02 refund is charged_total 65.13 less 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to SGD 21.80 (above the 0.50 de minimis floor; 33.4% of the charge, below the 90% full-refund share on that limb alone).

5. POL-RD-06 raises that partial to a full refund. A material deviation makes the driver_profile check mandatory, and EV-DPROF-00105 shows deviation_flags_90d of 4, at or above the clause's threshold of 3 - the repeat-deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED. That artifact is IMPAIRED: weight 0.75, issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (snapshot 2026-07-11T08:00, 108 hours before filing, against a 72-hour threshold), so its counters may lag the driver's state on the trip date and I have not treated the counter as current. The finding survives the discount - 4 against a threshold of 3. Because the deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) licenses FULL_REFUND of the charged total in place of the POL-RD-02 partial. Side by side: POL-RD-02 figure SGD 21.80; POL-RD-06(b) uplifted figure SGD 65.13 (a difference of SGD 43.33). No pass-through line is uplifted and none exists: ERP is 0.00, and the 0.00 airport_surcharge line is correct rather than a defect because the Changi surcharge attaches only to trips ORIGINATING at the airport and this trip terminates there. POL-RD-09 therefore adds nothing on top of the refund, and there is no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4).

6. Confidence. The uplift rests on EV-DPROF-00105 at weight 0.75, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped at 0.75. That is above the 0.70 platform floor, so no POL-RD-10(1) escalation. The deviation itself is carried by EV-GPS-00105 and EV-TRIP-00105 at weight 1.0.

7. On the discarded material: the rider's claim that POL-RD-03 cannot run, and the rider's framing of the POL-RD-06(c) referral, were both discarded at the mechanical stage for citing impaired artifacts (EV-ADVIS-00105-01; EV-DPROF-00105) without naming their issue codes. The referral in this ruling is not built on either discarded claim: it follows from POL-RD-06(c) itself, which directs a conduct referral once the pattern is established, and the pattern is established on the surviving evidence. The context-only profile fields mentioned on the driver's side (rating, prior_disputes_filed, prior_no_show_flags, prior_deviation_flags, acceptance_rate) were not used as a ground of decision, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

Result: FULL_REFUND of SGD 65.13 to the rider, with the driver referred to conduct review under POL-RD-06(c).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
referrals: POL-RD-06(c) driver-conduct review: refer driver DRV-00932 to conduct review. A repeat-deviation pattern is established on EV-DPROF-00105 (weight 0.75, issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT; deviation_flags_90d 4 against the clause's threshold of 3) alongside a MATERIAL deviation substantiated on this trip's own evidence (EV-GPS-00105, EV-TRIP-00105). Per POL-GEN-03 this referral does not displace or delay the monetary ruling.
